# Fremantle Fish & Ice Co, Fremantle WA
Fictional test records as at 9 November 2026.

## Open customer orders
- Bathers Beach Bistro, order FFI-101, due 12 November. Needs two Dhufish Whole 10kg, four King Prawns U10 5kg and ten Block Ice 20kg.
- Portside Fish and Chips, order FFI-102, due 12 November. Needs six Gummy Shark 5kg and twelve Flake Ice 10kg.
- Harbour Lights Hotel Group, order FFI-103, due 13 November. Needs three Greenlip Abalone 1kg, five Tiger Prawns 5kg and eight Party Ice 5kg.
- Saltwater Table Restaurant, order FFI-104, due 12 November. Needs four Snapper Fillets 5kg and six Crushed Ice 5kg.
- Quay Seafood Kitchen, order FFI-105, due 14 November. Needs three Octopus 5kg and five Prawn Meat 1kg.
- West End Oyster Bar, order FFI-106, due 14 November. Needs two Brownlip Abalone 1kg, four Cooked Prawns 2kg and six Gel Ice Pack 1kg.

## Inbound load
Refrigerated truck Reefer 2 is carrying inbound load IN-42, expected 11 November 2026. It carries two Dhufish Whole 10kg for FFI-101, six Gummy Shark 5kg for FFI-102, three Greenlip Abalone 1kg for FFI-103 and four Snapper Fillets 5kg for FFI-104. A one-day delay risks those four orders. Dispatch lead is Amelia Russo.

## Decisions and unconfirmed information
Decision: delivery minimum goes to $250 from 1 December 2026, approved by owner Amelia Russo.
Rumour, unconfirmed: Shark Bay Prawns may raise prices in December. No increase is confirmed.
Shark Bay Prawns is our prawn supplier. Southern Ice Works supplies ice and insulated packaging. Both are organisations we work with.
Esperance Abalone has a Greenlip Abalone 1kg consignment on order for Harbour Lights Hotel Group.
Unlinked equipment: Office Label Printer sits in dispatch, with no recorded dependencies.
